meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你的屏幕操作，自动发现重复研究流程并生成新技能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常重复相似的研究操作，想把这些模式变成可复用的技能。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat similar research steps and want to turn them into reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取本机屏幕记录(需先装 screenpipe),找出你反复出现的工作套路,和现有技能比对,然后草拟新技能或组合已有技能的方案,供你审核修改。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求分析最近一段时间的工作、找出未被覆盖的重复流程、或根据近期操作起草技能时触发;需本机 screenpipe 服务在运行,且必须由用户显式发起。

say.text: 分析我最近一天的操作,提出几个新技能方案。
say.note: 会先检查 screenpipe 是否可用,再产出草案。

say.text: 看看我这周重复做的事里,哪些还没有现成技能?
say.note: 会比对已有技能,列出缺口。

say.text: 根据我最近的研究流程,草拟一个组合已有技能的配方。
say.note: 会生成一份可审核的 SKILL.md 草稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read the local screen-recording history (via the screenpipe daemon), detect repeated workflow patterns, compare them with existing skills, and draft new skills or composition recipes for user review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to analyze recent work, find uncovered repeated workflows, or draft skills from recent activity. Requires the local screenpipe daemon on port 3030.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of activity and propose some new skill ideas.
say_en.note: Checks screenpipe availability first, then drafts proposals.

say_en.text: Review this week's repeats and tell me what's not covered yet.
say_en.note: Compares clusters against existing skills and lists gaps.

say_en.text: Draft a composition recipe from my recent research workflow.
